product.name: Appchains
product.description: Customizable, community-owned blockchains that allow developers to control network rules, sequencing, and economic incentives.

product.name: Onchain Sequencing Infrastructure
product.description: A system that manages transaction ordering and validation on appchains, enabling programmable and community-controlled sequencing.

product.name: Degen Chain
product.description: A public Layer 3 rollup chain built on Arbitrum Orbit and Base, designed for developers to build scalable applications with community ownership.

product.name: Adrift Gaming Appchain
product.description: A gaming-specific appchain that uses programmable onchain sequencing to deliver low-latency, verifiable randomness and community-controlled gameplay.

product.name: Dreamchain
product.description: An AI-operated blockchain where autonomous agents govern and execute transactions, with token holders staking into the sequencer for ownership and revenue sharing.
